subject: Render DELTA6 limit change: maxColorAttachments 2 -> 4
body:
Device limit is now `limits.maxColorAttachments=4` in render-owned `device_limits.h`, matching the 4-slot generic MRT admission and the host-tested path_cubic four-attachment descriptor. Arch9 supports up to 8; this publishes only the implemented 4-target class and does not claim hardware qualification.

`framework_device_probe.inc` (root-owned) still asserts 2 in two places and must be updated by root to 4 together with the probe expectation; render did not edit it. No other query value changed. Host worker test sets capabilities directly and passes; ARM64 syntax passes. No phone/native/commit.

Final device_limits hash will be posted with the next STATUS/ready hash set.
